We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-4 & 6 & 2 \\ 5 & -3 & 7 \\ 1 & 8 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ -1 \\ 4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}-4\cdot 3 & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,6\cdot (-1) & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,2\cdot 4 \\ 5\cdot 3 & + & (-3)\cdot (-1) & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,7\cdot 4 \\ 1\cdot 3 & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,8\cdot (-1) & + & (-2)\cdot 4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-12 & + & (-6) & + & 8 \\ 15 & + & 3 & + & 28 \\ 3 & + & (-8) & + & (-8)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-10 \\ 46 \\ -13\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
